name: guarded-dissipation-prevents-damage-equal-to-greatest-sword-power-and-draws
notes: Guarded Dissipation: prevent the next X damage where X is the greatest Sword power you control (1). Pre-fix the effect was PREVENT_ALL_ with no amount. (Level 0: no draw.)

rulesClauses: Prevent the next X damage that would be dealt to target unit this turn where X is the greatest power among Sword weapons you control.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Guarded Dissipation: the generated handler ($maxPower) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
